purpose: Compatible instance binding changes the actual factory receiver/called class; the original callable/receiver retire before invocation and the bound callable/new receiver retire before its private-static Generator.
source:
<?php
class Mid82 {
    private static function body() {
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Mid82', '|', static::class === 'New82', '|';
        try { yield 82; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|'; }
    }
    public function make() {
        global $weakNew;
        echo 'MAKE|', __CLASS__ === 'Mid82', '|', static::class === 'New82', '|',
             $this === $weakNew->get(), '|';
        return self::body();
    }
}
class Old82 extends Mid82 {
    public static function body() { echo 'BAD-OLD|'; yield 0; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OLD|'; }
}
class New82 extends Mid82 {
    public static function body() { echo 'BAD-NEW|'; yield 0; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'NEW|'; }
}
$old = new Old82();
$new = new New82();
$weakOld = WeakReference::create($old);
$weakNew = WeakReference::create($new);
$source = $old->make(...);
$weakSource = WeakReference::create($source);
$bound = $source->bindTo($new);
$weakBound = WeakReference::create($bound);
unset($source, $old);
echo 'OLD-RETIRED|', $weakSource->get() === null, '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|';
$g = $bound();
unset($bound, $new);
echo 'FRESH|', $weakBound->get() === null, '|', $weakNew->get() === null, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current() === 82, '|';
unset($g, $weakOld, $weakNew, $weakSource, $weakBound);
echo 'E';

purpose: Compatible instance binding preserves a parent protected Generator on the real rebound receiver through close; original source/old receiver retire without becoming owners.

<?php
class Base82B {
    protected function body() {
        global $weakNew;
        echo 'BODY|', $this === $weakNew->get(), '|';
        try { yield 82; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|', $this === $weakNew->get(), '|'; }
    }
}
class Mid82B extends Base82B {
    public function make() {
        global $weakNew;
        echo 'MAKE|', __CLASS__ === 'Mid82B', '|', static::class === 'New82B', '|',
             $this === $weakNew->get(), '|';
        return parent::body();
    }
}
class Old82B extends Mid82B {
    public function body() { echo 'BAD-OLD|'; yield 0; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OLD|'; }
}
class New82B extends Mid82B {
    public function body() { echo 'BAD-NEW|'; yield 0; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'NEW|'; }
}
$old = new Old82B();
$new = new New82B();
$weakOld = WeakReference::create($old);
$weakNew = WeakReference::create($new);
$source = $old->make(...);
$weakSource = WeakReference::create($source);
$bound = $source->bindTo($new);
$weakBound = WeakReference::create($bound);
unset($source, $old);
echo 'OLD-RETIRED|', $weakSource->get() === null, '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|';
$g = $bound();
unset($bound, $new);
echo 'FRESH|', $weakBound->get() === null, '|', $weakNew->get() instanceof New82B, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current() === 82, '|';
unset($g);
echo 'AFTER|', $weakNew->get() === null, '|';

purpose: A static method binding with null receiver probes the actual called-scope result; original Leaf capture retires before the bound factory selects its protected static body.

<?php
class Mid82C {
    public static function make() {
        echo 'MAKE|', __CLASS__ === 'Mid82C', '|', static::class === 'Mid82C', '|';
        return static::body();
    }
    protected static function body() {
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Mid82C', '|', static::class === 'Mid82C', '|';
        yield 82;
        return 83;
    }
}
class Leaf82C extends Mid82C {
    protected static function body() { echo 'BAD-LEAF|'; yield 0; }
}
$source = Leaf82C::make(...);
$weakSource = WeakReference::create($source);
$bound = $source->bindTo(null);
$weakBound = WeakReference::create($bound);
unset($source);
echo 'RETIRED|', $weakSource->get() === null, '|';
$g = $bound();
unset($bound);
echo 'FRESH|', $weakBound->get() === null, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current() === 82, '|';
$g->next();
echo 'RETURN|', $g->getReturn() === 83, '|';
unset($g, $weakSource, $weakBound);
echo 'E';

purpose: A private inherited method capture passes through Closure::bind then bindTo on compatible receivers. Original and intermediate callables/receivers retire before the final factory invokes the original Base method on Final. The final callable/receiver then retire before its static byref Generator body; primed SEND and supplied Fiber abort distinguish real API-input and reference-cache owners.

<?php
class Token82R {
    function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; }
}
class Input82R {
    function __construct() {
        global $weakInput;
        $weakInput = WeakReference::create($this);
    }
    function __destruct() { echo 'INPUT|'; }
}
class Base82R {
    public function capture() { return $this->make(...); }
    private function make(&$token) {
        global $weakFinal;
        echo 'MAKE|', __CLASS__ === 'Base82R', '|', static::class === 'Final82R', '|',
             $this === $weakFinal->get(), '|';
        return self::body($token);
    }
    private static function &body(&$token) {
        global $weakToken, $weakInput;
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Base82R', '|', static::class === 'Final82R', '|';
        try {
            $received = yield $token;
            echo 'RECEIVED|', $received === $weakInput->get(), '|';
            unset($received);
            Fiber::suspend('bound82');
            echo 'BAD-RESUME|';
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token82R, '|',
                 $weakInput->get() instanceof Input82R, '|';
        }
    }
}
class Old82R extends Base82R {
    public function make(&$token) { echo 'BAD-OLD|'; return []; }
    function __destruct() { echo 'OLD|'; }
}
class Middle82R extends Base82R {
    public function make(&$token) { echo 'BAD-MIDDLE|'; return []; }
    function __destruct() { echo 'MIDDLE|'; }
}
class Final82R extends Base82R {
    public function make(&$token) { echo 'BAD-FINAL|'; return []; }
    function __destruct() { echo 'FINAL|'; }
}
function Run82R() {
    global $g;
    echo 'SEND|';
    $g->send(new Input82R());
    echo 'BAD-CALLER|';
}
$old = new Old82R();
$middle = new Middle82R();
$final = new Final82R();
$weakOld = WeakReference::create($old);
$weakMiddle = WeakReference::create($middle);
$weakFinal = WeakReference::create($final);
$source = $old->capture();
$weakSource = WeakReference::create($source);
$first = Closure::bind($source, $middle);
$weakFirst = WeakReference::create($first);
$last = $first->bindTo($final);
$weakLast = WeakReference::create($last);
unset($source, $first, $old, $middle);
echo 'RETIRED|', $weakSource->get() === null, '|', $weakFirst->get() === null, '|',
     $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $weakMiddle->get() === null, '|';
$token = new Token82R();
$alias =& $token;
$weakToken = WeakReference::create($token);
$g = $last($token);
unset($last, $final, $token);
$token = 82;
echo 'FRESH|', $weakLast->get() === null, '|', $weakFinal->get() === null, '|',
     $weakToken->get() instanceof Token82R, '|';
echo 'PRIME|';
$g->current();
$fiber = new Fiber('Run82R');
$stop = new Exception('stop82');
echo 'START|';
$mark = $fiber->start();
unset($alias);
echo 'PARK|', $mark === 'bound82', '|', $g->current() === $weakToken->get(), '|',
     $token === 82, '|', $weakInput->get() instanceof Input82R, '|';
echo 'ABORT|';
try { $fiber->throw($stop); }
catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo 'OUT|', $e === $stop, '|', $e->getPrevious() === null, '|',
         $fiber->isTerminated(), '|', $weakInput->get() === null, '|',
         $weakToken->get() instanceof Token82R, '|';
}
echo 'CLOSED|', $g->current() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token82R, '|';
unset($g, $fiber, $stop, $e);
echo 'DROP|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|E';
